sections.html:
Hirsutism = androgen-dependent excessive male-pattern hair growth in woman

  1. ประเมิน Hirsutism scoring scale of Ferriman and Gallwey: < 8 = normal, ≥ 8 = work up cause
  2. ส่งตรวจพื้นฐาน: Free testosterone level, DHEAS level
  3. ส่งตรวจเพิ่มเติม: Dexamethasone suppression test, ACTH stimulation test
  • Hyperandrogenism
    • Gonadal: PCOS, Ovarian hyperandrogenism, Ovarian neoplasm
    • Adrenal: CAH, Adrenal neoplasm
    • Peripheral conversion: Obesity, Idiopathic
  • Other endocrine d/o: Cushing’s syndrome, Hyperprolactinemia, Acromegaly
  • Drug: Androgens; OCP containing androgenic progestins; Minoxidil, Phenytoin; Diazoxide, Cyclosporine
  • True hermaphroditism

High level of androgen → ทำให้เกิด Masculinization ร่วมกับอาการดังต่อไปนี้

  • Increase libido
  • deepening of the voice, breast atrophy, clitoromegaly

สาเหตุ: Ovarian neoplasm · Adrenal neoplasm
